dish: Pork tamago onigiri (Spam-and-egg rice sandwich, made to order)
n: Pork Tamago Onigiri Honten, Makishi (ポークたまごおにぎり本店)
w: The flagship of the 'Pōtama' shop that turned Okinawa's pork-and-egg onigiri into a takeaway icon; each one is pressed to order so the rice is hot and the egg fluffy. Opens early (7:00) for breakfast, closed Wednesdays.

dish: Fujiya zenzai (shaved ice over slow-simmered kintoki beans, the ice made from the bean syrup)
n: Fujiya Tomari Honten (富士家 泊本店)
w: The name many Okinawans give first for zenzai: fluffy shaved ice frozen from the bean-cooking syrup so it never dilutes, heaped over sweet kintoki beans. Open daily, later hours in summer.

dish: Fresh Okinawan tuna sashimi and kaisen-don bought downstairs and eaten on the 2F terrace
n: Tomari Iyumachi Fish Market (泊いゆまち)
w: The Okinawa fisheries co-op's market by Tomari Port, where about 70 percent of the catch sold is tuna, delivered unfrozen the day it is landed. Stalls sell sashimi, seafood bowls, shellfish and mozuku to eat on the upstairs terrace.
